title: §14-002: Cluster Module & TCP Load Distribution
description: Multiple-choice practice questions and deep runtime verification for §14-002 (Cluster Module & TCP Load Distribution).

cards.concept: Cluster Module & TCP Load Distribution: Worker Threads vs Cluster Module
cards.question: What is the primary architectural difference between Node's `cluster` module and `worker_threads` module?

options.text: Cluster is only for Linux; worker_threads is only for Windows.
`cluster` forks separate OS child processes with independent memory heaps sharing server ports; `worker_threads` runs multiple V8 isolates in the same process with shared memory support.
worker_threads cannot perform file I/O.
cluster requires Docker to operate.

cards.explanation: Cluster scales I/O across multi-core CPUs via separate child processes. worker_threads runs multiple V8 isolates within the same process for CPU-heavy tasks with SharedArrayBuffer access.
cards.pitfall: Using worker_threads for standard non-blocking I/O tasks adds thread synchronization overhead without performance gains.
cards.citation: Node.js API Reference: worker_threads vs cluster

cards.concept: Cluster Module & TCP Load Distribution: SharedArrayBuffer & Atomics Operations
cards.question: Why MUST multi-threaded operations on `SharedArrayBuffer` use `Atomics` methods (e.g. `Atomics.add`, `Atomics.wait`)?

options.text: SharedArrayBuffer is read-only unless unlocked by Atomics.
Atomics operations prevent race conditions and memory corruption by guaranteeing atomic, non-interruptible read-modify-write memory access across threads.
Atomics encrypts shared memory.
Atomics converts binary buffers into JSON objects.

cards.explanation: When multiple worker threads access shared memory, concurrent writes produce race conditions. Atomics operations guarantee hardware-level atomic operations and synchronization barriers.
cards.pitfall: Calling Atomics.wait() on the Node.js main thread throws a TypeError because blocking the main event loop thread is prohibited.
cards.citation: MDN Web Docs: Atomics / SharedArrayBuffer Specifications
